notes.title: Remastered ZSG trailer!!
notes.content: ZSG is looking better than ever and continuously evolving!!!

notes.title: ZSG UPDATE 3
notes.content:
1: ZSG is now much higher resolution!

2: Weapons do 2X more damage

3: Upgrades are cheaper and faster to buy

4: Zombie speed increases 9% per round instead of 3%

5: The 4 second round transition delay is now reduced to 0 seconds, zombies instantly re-spawn when all zombies are killed

6: High scores are reset due to difficulty increase

7: The map "Outpost" is now dark and the weapon is equipped with a flashlight

notes.title: ZSG UPDATE 2
notes.content:
1: The game is finally full screen!!

2: The highest round survived will now be saved as a separate high score

3: The high score will now be multiplied with the highest round survived before being added to the "PLAYER SCORE"
